name: HMs without the move
author: PokePat
description: Cut, Rock Smash, Strength, Surf, Waterfall and Rock Climb work when the player owns the HM and the badge – no Pokémon has to know the move. Press A at the tree, rock, water … or choose "Pokémon" in the start menu while facing it. A Pokémon that knows the move is shown when there is one, otherwise the first one in the party.
